news.title: Debt-hungry AI companies face increased risk as bond yields spike
news.description: The AI infrastructure buildout shows no sign of slowing, but the surge in Treasury yields means it's at least going to cost more.

news.title: At NFL games this season, drone defense tech aims to bring down disruptions
news.description: The NFL told CNBC it recorded 10,852 drone violations over stadiums between 2021 and 2025. The Jaguars became the first team to sign a drone defense firm.

news.title: Wall Street money takes back over from small investors as driving force of the stock market
news.description: One firm sees a "reasonably constructive signal for risk appetite" among institutional investors.
